description: The agent must: (1) Read and parse three heterogeneous source files (CSV, plaintext, JSON with wrong field names) and extract all 10 candidates. (2) Apply the proprietary status enum mapping: Chinese values only - 初筛/面试/Offer/拒绝/入职/人才库 - with special attention to: 赵磊's unconfirmed Offer→'Offer' status, 周建国's accepted offer→'入职' status, 吴浩's '建议人才库'→'人才库' status. (3) Generate a dashboard with ALL 6 status keys present even if count=0, and total matching candidate count. (4) Produce reminders using Chinese priority values (高/中/低): 王强 (18 days no contact) must get 高 priority; 赵磊 (Offer >3 days unconfirmed) must get a reminder. (5) Generate alerts including follow-up lag alert for 王强 and Offer waiting alert for 赵磊. (6) Output candidate_tracking_report.json following the exact schema with fields: id, name, position, status, stage, tags(array≥2), source, applied_date, last_contact, next_action(with 高/中/低 priority), notes, history. (7) Output candidate_dashboard.md following the template with emoji section headers (📊状态看板, 🔄待处理操作, ⚠️警告, 📋候选人详情) and a pipe-table format status dashboard.
